title: Section 605.1(A) – Revise Section 605.1(A) to read as follows:
officialText:
605.1(A) Covered. This article covers electrical equipment, lighting accessories, and wiring systems used to connect,
contained within, or installed on office furnishings. All such office furnishings shall be listed and labeled. Furniture
systems that are not listed shall be installed using wiring methods in accordance with Chapter 3.
Informational Note: Refer to Annex A, Product Safety Standards, for applicable standards.
